project_info.theme: Mega sale with spend threshold and free random merchandise
project_info.color_palette: White, Bright Yellow, Black, Warm Gold, Accent Red

main_subject.detail: A white ecommerce poster with a black {{SALE_HEADLINE}} at the top, an arcing lineup of REF_CAMPAIGN_PRODUCTS, and a large rounded yellow gift panel below for {{GIFT_HEADLINE}} plus REF_MERCH_LINEUP.
main_subject.style: Clean high-volume retail sale composition, cutout packshots, bold poster typography

items: Top: Large black sale headline and small yellow limited-gift tag.
Upper/Middle: REF_CAMPAIGN_PRODUCTS distributed along a broad looping yellow stroke.
Center: Black plus icon dividing the sale lineup from the offer panel.
Lower: Rounded yellow panel containing time, spend threshold, gift headline, and REF_MERCH_LINEUP.
Bottom: Optional CTA placement inside the lower offer panel.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Clean white negative space, soft product shadows, energetic yellow ribbon motion

technical_specs.render_style: High fidelity ecommerce sale poster with realistic product and merch packshots

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: Create a square Ultimate Sup mega-sale poster on white. Set {{SALE_HEADLINE}} across the top, arrange REF_CAMPAIGN_PRODUCTS along a looping yellow ribbon in the upper half, place a black plus icon at the center, and use a large rounded yellow lower panel for {{DATE_WINDOW}}, {{SPEND_THRESHOLD}}, {{GIFT_HEADLINE}}, and REF_MERCH_LINEUP. Add {{LIMITED_GIFT_LABEL}} only if approved. Preserve clean white space and high-value ecommerce packshot clarity.
prompt.negative_prompt: unapproved product, incorrect threshold, distorted product labels, overcrowded arc, unreadable gift headline, dark background, watermark, cropped merchandise

assets.name: Mega-sale ribbon and gift-panel composition
assets.usage: Preserve top headline, curved product arc, central plus icon, and lower rounded offer panel.

assets.name: Sale SKU packshots
assets.usage: Replace the upper product arc without changing its broad distribution.

assets.name: Free merchandise/gift packshots
assets.usage: Place inside the yellow lower offer panel.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach REF_LAYOUT, REF_CAMPAIGN_PRODUCTS, and REF_MERCH_LINEUP. Keep product-label and commercial terms exact by compositing final text after generation.

substitutable_fields.default: 8PM 7 AUG - 0AM 11 AUG / MIN. SPEND $60 / FREE 1 RANDOM MERCH
substitutable_fields.replacement_rule: Use current approved SGD terms only.

substitutable_fields.default: T-shirt, shaker, bag, accessory, or campaign SKU
substitutable_fields.replacement_rule: Swap only with approved gift assets.
